claim_comment: Defining immutable post-settlement coding-agent observations with canonical payloads, exact source/scope/provenance/privacy, stable crash-safe idempotency, out-of-order/duplicate tolerance, bounded batches, and truthful attempt receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Observation envelopes are immutable, versioned, bounded, exact-scope, provider/registration/readiness pinned, canonically normalized, and carry settled source identity, provenance, privacy, retention, deadline, and cancellation.
Idempotency keys are deterministic across retries, dispatch restart, provider restart, and topology; same-key/same-payload is duplicate acknowledgement and same-key/different-payload is conflict.
Providers tolerate duplicate and out-of-order at-least-once delivery; batch limits come from handshake ceilings and partial/unknown effects are reported rather than hidden.

Canonical TraceDecay settlement always precedes observation and provider admission, latency, failure, duplicate, conflict, cancellation, timeout, or partial effect cannot change the source result or influence observer-mode product behavior.
close_reason: Accepted the V1 post-settlement provider observation contract with canonical normalization, stable crash-safe idempotency, exact provenance/privacy/scope, bounded at-least-once batching, immutable delivery receipts, and mechanical observer non-interference.
close_comment: Evidence: product/contracts/memory-provider-v1/provider-observation-contract.json, strict top-level schema, and documentation define nineteen-field immutable envelopes, nine admitted coding-agent source/kind mappings, RFC 8785/NFC normalization without floats/duplicate keys/provider-specific shapes, deterministic SHA-256 payload/envelope/idempotency identities, persisted provider deduplication, required provenance and privacy/retention/forget metadata, monotonic source sequence without delivery-order assumptions, homogeneous handshake-bounded batches, ten-step post-settlement admission/dispatch ordering, thirteen typed provider outcomes, and immutable per-attempt receipts with committed-effect state. Same key/same digest is duplicate; same key/different digest is conflict; random/timestamp retry keys, unadmitted secrets, missing provenance/privacy, source paths, atomic-batch assumptions, success without acknowledgement, provider retention extension, and observer influence are forbidden. scripts/product/check-provider-observation-contract.py cross-checks the registry/handshake dependencies, exact structures, kinds, identities, bounds, algorithms, Beads IDs, schema, docs, receipts, and non-interference. tests/product_provider_observation_contract_test.py injects unsettled-source, identity, normalization, idempotency, provenance, privacy, ordering, batch, receipt, observer, Beads, and schema failures.
